subject: Post-discovery: Schedule 30-min product demo for FinBank
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finbank.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: Schedule 30-min product demo for FinBank

Hi Jordan — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: 

- Current pain: slow batch scoring, high token costs on customer-facing features, and limited model routing flexibility.
- Goal: reduce inference cost by ~30% while keeping sub-500ms p95 latency for search/autocomplete flows.
- Stakeholders: you (Head of Data), Priya (CTO) — Vanessa (our SE) will join the demo for technical questions.

Next step: propose a 30-minute product intro/demo + quick SE Q&A. Please pick one of these options (all PT):

1) Tue Apr 21 — 10:00–10:30
2) Wed Apr 22 — 14:00–14:30
3) Thu Apr 23 — 09:30–10:00

If none of these work, send a couple windows that do and we’ll adjust. Attached is a one-page mutual action plan (MAP_FinBank_v1.pdf) and a short Redwood deck so your team can review before the demo.

Agenda for the 30-min call (we’ll adapt if you want a deeper tech dive):
- 5m intro & goals
- 15m demo: routing, caching, and cost controls
- 8m SE Q&A (Vanessa)
- 2m next steps/commitments

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
